name: pivotick-graph-transformer
description: Community-maintained converters that turn third-party graph data (MISP, STIX, VirusTotal Graph, AIL-framework, ...) into data the Pivotick graph visualization library can render.

scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace=pivotick-transformer-core --workspace=pivotick-transformer-misp && npm run dev --workspace=pivotick-transformer-demo
